title: Hayabusa 25th Anniversary (Track Edition)
description: The Suzuki Hayabusa 25th Anniversary (Track Edition) is engineered for blistering apex speeds and track dominance, occupying a prominent position in the Urban Roadster segment. Its tuned powertrain delivers immediate, tractable torque against its responsive chassis architecture, ensuring responsive roll-on acceleration in demanding road conditions. The cockpit is configured with an Upright Neutral stance and a balanced 790mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort, prioritizing aerodynamic tuck and front-end circuit precision over casual urban commuting.
